description: This Java source file defines the DateVariable class, which extends BaseVariable to represent a Date type variable within a larger code generation or serialization framework. It includes methods for encoding/decoding JSON, C code, and Java code, and indicates that the variable is a date type with associated metadata.

classes.name: DateVariable
classes.description: Represents a Date variable with serialization, encoding, and decoding capabilities, extending BaseVariable.

methods.name: DateVariable(ICDateVariable bean)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the variable with a given ICDateVariable bean.

methods.name: DateVariable(String varName)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the variable with a specified name.

methods.name: resolveReferences
methods.description: Resolves references; no action needed for DateVariable.

methods.name: isDate
methods.description: Indicates that this variable is of date type, always returns true.

methods.name: getCtype
methods.description: Returns the C language type 'uint64_t' for date variables.

methods.name: getJavaIpcObjectType
methods.description: Returns the Java IPC object type 'DateIPC'.

methods.name: getJsonKey
methods.description: Returns the JSON key associated with date variables, from TemplateMappings.

methods.name: getNativeEncodeLines
methods.description: Generates C code lines to encode the date variable into JSON, supporting array and object contexts.

methods.name: getNativeDecodeLines
methods.description: Generates C code lines to decode the date variable from JSON, assuming milliseconds since epoch.

methods.name: getJavaEncodeLines
methods.description: Generates Java code lines to encode the date variable into JSON.

methods.name: getJavaDecodeLines
methods.description: Generates Java code lines to decode the date variable from JSON.
